title: Confounders and controls
goals: Explain the mechanism and terminology of confounders and controls
Apply the stated procedure to a new case with a traceable result
Identify an assumption or limitation and design a revealing follow-up
vocabulary: A differing condition offering another explanation
A design constraint preserving comparison conditions
Varying order to reduce systematic order differences

blocks.text: New method uses better corpus and different queries while old method uses the original set.
Corpus and case differences confound the method effect. Rerun matched inputs or report a whole-system comparison without isolation.

Compare the intermediate evidence with the final statement. Explain why each number or decision follows from the stated inputs. The conclusion belongs to this scenario and procedure; changing the inputs, evaluation population or authority can change what it establishes. Retain the raw record so a later revision can be compared honestly.

guided_practice.title: Trace the worked case
guided_practice.prompt: New method uses better corpus and different queries while old method uses the original set. Show the intermediate steps and give the conclusion with its scope.
guided_practice.answer: Teacher explanation: Corpus and case differences confound the method effect. Rerun matched inputs or report a whole-system comparison without isolation.

independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: Every method A run is morning and B run afternoon; network speed varies by time. Propose a repair.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: Counterbalance/randomise method order under matched conditions and record time; otherwise timing remains an alternative explanation.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
Controls address specified alternatives, not every possible unknown confounder.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: For a toy comparison vary only retrieval method while holding corpus, queries, cutoff and relevance rubric fixed. Randomise or counterbalance order when order effects matter.
